description: Who and what can reach this MCP server. auth_mode, tool_gate, tool_scope, tool_lock, rate_limit, protocols, and ui_auth are admin. audit turns the call trace on or off and follows the write scope: open needs no key, writes and all need write. describe_server shows the result and cannot be locked or disabled. Call get_schema with name server_access for every action's fields.

action.description: auth_mode: Set mode: open, writes, or all. Needs mode. | tool_gate: Enable or disable one tool (a bundle name disables every action). Needs tool_name, enabled. | tool_scope: Set scope to read-only, write, destructive, or default. Needs tool_name, scope. | tool_lock: Lock one tool so it needs the admin scope, or unlock it. Needs tool_name, locked. | rate_limit: Set enabled, limit, and windowSeconds per caller. Needs enabled. | protocols: Turn stdio, streamableHttp, and sse on or off (pass all three). Needs stdio, streamableHttp, sse. | audit: Turn the audit trace on or off. Pass enabled true or false. Not admin: open mode needs no key. Needs enabled. | ui_auth: Hide the dashboard pages until an admin signs in. Needs enabled.

name: server_access
